title: Leviticus 20: The Judgments Appointed for the Abominations
body:
Read the chapter → [Leviticus 20](/bible/leviticus/20)

**[Leviticus 20:1-5](/bible/leviticus/20#v1)**

> <sup>[1](/bible/leviticus/20#v1)</sup> And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
>
> <sup>[2](/bible/leviticus/20#v2)</sup> Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
>
> <sup>[3](/bible/leviticus/20#v3)</sup> And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
>
> <sup>[4](/bible/leviticus/20#v4)</sup> And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
>
> <sup>[5](/bible/leviticus/20#v5)</sup> Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

- Whosoever of Israel or of the strangers in the land gave of his seed unto Molech was surely put to death; the people of the land stoned him with stones. This is the child sacrifice shown in [Ezekiel 16](/bible/ezekiel/16), slaying the children of the Most High and delivering them to pass through the fire.
- If the people of the land hid their eyes from the man and killed him not, the Most High set His face against that man and against his family. When you see wickedness you must utter it and expose it; a witness that holds his peace bears iniquity.
- Sin brings judgment on a whole house. Achan coveted the goodly Babylonish garment, the silver, and the wedge of gold, and he and his sons and his daughters and all that he had were stoned and burned in the valley of Achor. What you do is not just about you; your sin can bring judgment on your family.

  Precepts:
  - **[Ezekiel 16:20-21](/bible/ezekiel/16#v20)**
    > <sup>[20](/bible/ezekiel/16#v20)</sup> Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
    >
    > <sup>[21](/bible/ezekiel/16#v21)</sup> That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?

    Thou hast slain my children to cause them to pass through the fire; that is giving seed unto Molech.
  - **[Leviticus 5:1](/bible/leviticus/5#v1)**
    > <sup>[1](/bible/leviticus/5#v1)</sup> And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

    If a soul hear swearing and is a witness and do not utter it, he shall bear his iniquity; wickedness seen must be exposed.
  - **[Joshua 7:20-25](/bible/joshua/7#v20)**
    > <sup>[20](/bible/joshua/7#v20)</sup> And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
    >
    > <sup>[21](/bible/joshua/7#v21)</sup> When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
    >
    > <sup>[22](/bible/joshua/7#v22)</sup> So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
    >
    > <sup>[23](/bible/joshua/7#v23)</sup> And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.
    >
    > <sup>[24](/bible/joshua/7#v24)</sup> And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
    >
    > <sup>[25](/bible/joshua/7#v25)</sup> And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the Lord shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.

    Achan's covetousness brought stoning and fire on him and his whole house; one man's sin judged his family.

**[Leviticus 20:6-9](/bible/leviticus/20#v6)**

> <sup>[6](/bible/leviticus/20#v6)</sup> And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
>
> <sup>[7](/bible/leviticus/20#v7)</sup> Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.
>
> <sup>[8](/bible/leviticus/20#v8)</sup> And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.
>
> <sup>[9](/bible/leviticus/20#v9)</sup> For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

- The soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, is cut off from among his people.
- Sanctify yourselves and be ye holy; keep the statutes of the Most High, for He is the Lord which sanctifieth you.
- Every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death; his blood shall be upon him. Disrespecting your mother and your father carried the death penalty.

**[Leviticus 20:10](/bible/leviticus/20#v10)**

> <sup>[10](/bible/leviticus/20#v10)</sup> And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

- The man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress, shall surely be put to death. This world openly defends adultery and men even boast of committing it with another man's wife; the scriptures call for death upon both.

**[Leviticus 20:11-16](/bible/leviticus/20#v11)**

> <sup>[11](/bible/leviticus/20#v11)</sup> And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
>
> <sup>[12](/bible/leviticus/20#v12)</sup> And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
>
> <sup>[13](/bible/leviticus/20#v13)</sup> If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
>
> <sup>[14](/bible/leviticus/20#v14)</sup> And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
>
> <sup>[15](/bible/leviticus/20#v15)</sup> And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
>
> <sup>[16](/bible/leviticus/20#v16)</sup> And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

- The man that lies with his father's wife, and the man that lies with his daughter in law, shall surely be put to death; they have wrought confusion.
- If a man lie with mankind as he lieth with a woman, both have committed an abomination and shall surely be put to death; abomination means hateful and disgusting unto the Most High.
- The man that takes a wife and her mother is burnt with fire, both he and they, that there be no wickedness among you.
- The man or woman that lies with a beast is put to death, and the beast is slain also. All of these judgments fall under the laws of adultery, the sub-statutes of that commandment.

**[Leviticus 20:17-21](/bible/leviticus/20#v17)**

> <sup>[17](/bible/leviticus/20#v17)</sup> And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
>
> <sup>[18](/bible/leviticus/20#v18)</sup> And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
>
> <sup>[19](/bible/leviticus/20#v19)</sup> And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
>
> <sup>[20](/bible/leviticus/20#v20)</sup> And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
>
> <sup>[21](/bible/leviticus/20#v21)</sup> And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

- The man that takes his sister and sees her nakedness, it is a wicked thing; they are cut off in the sight of their people, and he bears his iniquity.
- The man that lies with a woman having her sickness, her menstrual cycle, has discovered her fountain, and both are cut off from among their people; this goes with the laws of [Leviticus 15](/bible/leviticus/15).
- The nakedness of the mother's sister and the father's sister is near kin; they bear their iniquity. He that lies with his uncle's wife or takes his brother's wife, they shall die childless.

  Precepts:
  - **[Leviticus 15:19](/bible/leviticus/15#v19)**
    > <sup>[19](/bible/leviticus/15#v19)</sup> And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

    The law of the woman put apart in her issue; chapter 20 judges what chapter 15 defines.

**[Leviticus 20:22-24](/bible/leviticus/20#v22)**

> <sup>[22](/bible/leviticus/20#v22)</sup> Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
>
> <sup>[23](/bible/leviticus/20#v23)</sup> And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
>
> <sup>[24](/bible/leviticus/20#v24)</sup> But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people.

- Keep all my statutes and all my judgments, that the land whither I bring you spew you not out. Walk not in the manners of the nation cast out before you, for they committed all these things and therefore the Most High abhorred them.
- I am the Lord your God, which have separated you from other people. The Most High separated Israel from the other people, so Israel is to walk differently; these laws are the separation.

**[Leviticus 20:25-26](/bible/leviticus/20#v25)**

> <sup>[25](/bible/leviticus/20#v25)</sup> Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
>
> <sup>[26](/bible/leviticus/20#v26)</sup> And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

- Put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean; this goes back to [Leviticus 11](/bible/leviticus/11), the dietary laws. No shrimp, crab, lobster, pork, catfish, and the like; everything is not clean, whatever the church teaches.
- If you eat whatever you please, you are not separating yourself from the other nations. Ye shall be holy unto me, for I the Lord am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

**[Leviticus 20:27](/bible/leviticus/20#v27)**

> <sup>[27](/bible/leviticus/20#v27)</sup> A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

- A man or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, was surely put to death by stoning. The tarot card readings, the fortune telling, and the horoscopes of today are that same dealing with familiar spirits; do not touch any of it.
